answer: Run every newcomer through a supervised apprenticeship grove: each starts read-only, with zero voting weight, and must finish 50 graded micro-tasks in 30 days. A raven sentinel assigns tasks at random, three peers score each, and only apprentices passing 48 of 50 earn full membership. A sponsor stakes 200 POA per apprentice, lost on failure, while a whisper network flags matching failures within minutes. Forging 10,000 fakes means 500,000 tasks and $2,000,000 in forfeited stakes. Like a forest trusting saplings only after a full season of storms, trust is earned slowly, never bought.
